dsh-im
https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im

Penglai 0.5.7 does not install dsh-im as a runtime and does not copy generated
lib/ or bin/. Selected channel authentication and transport ideas may be
rewritten into @penglai/im under the MIT license below.
